review_findings.title: Wait for smoke process termination before uninstall
review_findings.details: launchAndStop calls child.kill() and resolves immediately; the NSIS uninstaller can run while the installed executable still holds a file lock, causing a false or timing-sensitive uninstall failure. Await child exit/close after kill with a bounded fallback before resolving the smoke step; retain error propagation and the installed-executable absence assertion.
